decision.observation: The car has left the tarmac and is out on dark grass among scattered boulders and thin trunks at 4 mph, gear 1, dots pale, no red X. The blue-lit road with puddles is now behind at the bottom-left of the frame, and a boulder sits directly in the headlight beam a short distance ahead. White marker posts are dotted around the grass.
decision.hypothesis: Forward throttle alone will carry the nose into the boulder ahead. A short left steer should swing the car around it and back toward the lit road at the bottom-left.
decision.memory: W+D after the log-stack unpin sent the car well clear of the lane into this boulder field. Boulders stop the car like pines, so they must be avoided while still slow.
